active_user_0_rtp_ratio.description: Fraction of users who received zero payout.

active_user_rtp_less_0_1_ratio.description: Fraction of users whose personal RTP is below 0.1 (10%). These users lost more than 90% of their wagers.

active_user_rtp_less_0_2_ratio.description: Fraction of users with personal RTP below 0.2 (20%).

active_user_rtp_less_0_3_ratio.description: Fraction of users with personal RTP below 0.3 (30%).

active_user_rtp_less_0_4_ratio.description: Fraction of users with personal RTP below 0.4 (40%). Monitors the share of players experiencing heavy losses (lost >60% of wagers).

active_user_rtp_less_0_5_ratio.description: Fraction of users with personal RTP below 0.5 (50%).

user_rtp_median.description: Median of individual user RTPs (user_total_payout / user_total_bet) across all users with non-zero bets. Reflects the 'typical' player experience, unlike the group-level rtp which is bet-weighted.

user_rtp_ultilization_ratio.description: Ratio of median user RTP to group-level RTP (user_rtp_median / rtp). Values near 1.0 mean payouts are evenly distributed across players. Values << 1.0 suggest a few high-rollers capture most of the payout.

user_group.description: User lifecycle segment based on how many days since the user's first bet in the game (first_bet_date from fct_bet_orders).

new.description: Users whose first bet in this game was within the last 3 calendar days.

beginner.description: Users whose first bet was 4–7 calendar days ago.

old.description: Users whose first bet was more than 7 calendar days ago.

user_group2.description: Alternative lifecycle segment with finer day-0 granularity.

day0_user.description: Brand-new users on the same calendar day as their very first bet.

day7+_user.description: Users 7 or more days after first bet.

ai_group.description: AB-test partition from the bet_orders table (partition_ab[0]). 'AI' = users assigned to the AI strategy; 'Default' = control group. Sub-groups like 'Default_<mathtable>' or individual math-table IDs are also generated for deeper analysis.

AI.description: Users in the AI-controlled AB group (partition_ab matches the AI group ID).

Default.description: Users NOT in the AI group (control / default strategy).

HG.description: Horizontal-group aggregate of ALL users regardless of AB partition.

daily_group.description: Fish Hunter (FM01) grouping column — varies by config. Typically the strategy_name or an AB-test partition.

SS01.notes: Base game (bg) is the regular paid spin. Free game (fg) is a bonus round triggered by the base game. fg bets use the triggering base-game bet amount.

FM01.notes: Each row in the bullet table represents one bullet fired. Fish have value tiers: low (<=10), medium (<=130), high (<=200), ultra (>200).
